static_checks.message: Must use the shipped contact lookup command
Must handle every contact lookup outcome
Must use scoped local contact discovery

static_checks.pattern: source URL, publication date, and access date
The default result is a draft in chat
static_checks.message: Must review competitive research before saving

evals.prompt: Look up jordan.lee@acme-corp.example.com and include any workspace affiliations.
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the local contact lookup and renders the returned outcome without external calls or writes
assertions: Uses `fieldkit contact find jordan.lee@acme-corp.example.com --affiliations --json`
Handles resolved, ambiguous, and not_found from the JSON type rather than assuming a match
Attributes affiliation data to workspace files and cached communication to the Gmail database
Does not write a contact note, account file, CRM record, or external resource

evals.prompt: Who is Jordan Lee at Acme Corp? There may be more than one match.
evals.expected_behavior: Presents bounded candidates and asks for an exact identity when lookup is ambiguous
assertions: Uses the supplied name as the local query
Shows email, display name, message count, and account only when returned
Does not select the first or busiest candidate
Reruns with the selected exact email

evals.prompt: What do we know about nobody@example.com?
evals.expected_behavior: Reports not_found honestly while preserving any separately returned workspace affiliations
assertions: Reports that the people index did not resolve nobody@example.com
Displays non-empty affiliations separately if the CLI returned them
Does not infer identity from the example.com domain
Does not automatically search an external service

evals.prompt: Draft competitive research for Acme Corp comparing our data platform with Northwind Analytics for an architecture review.
evals.expected_behavior: Builds a source-attributed battlecard draft from confirmed local scope and optional authorized public research
assertions: Confirms the Acme Corp account and exact pursuit before using account-specific files
Records source URL, publication date, and access date for public claims
Labels missing pricing, support, outcome, or version evidence unavailable
Presents the draft and source ledger without saving by default

evals.prompt: What are our win themes against competitors in this platform category? I have not named an account, competitor, or source set.
evals.expected_behavior: Keeps the request as a scoped research outline until the missing comparison inputs are supplied
assertions: Asks for the competitor or comparison set, product area, audience, and decision
Does not invent a win rate or reusable win/loss pattern
Marks account-specific evidence and internal context unavailable
Does not save a generic battlecard

evals.prompt: Discover locally known contacts for Acme Corp and report what was found.
evals.expected_behavior: Runs scoped local discovery and reports its writes and source coverage
assertions: Confirms the configured workspace before running `fieldkit contact enrich --discover --account acme-corp --json`
Reports the discovered count and source counts
Does not claim to refresh Gmail, Salesforce, Slack, or the web
Treats zero discovered contacts as a valid written result, not proof that no contacts exist

evals.prompt: Apply this reviewed Acme Corp web-result JSON to the local contact enrichment data.
evals.expected_behavior: Validates the source and destination, applies only missing supported fields, and reviews the merged local file
assertions: Confirms the configured workspace and reviewed web-search-results.json
Runs `fieldkit contact enrich --apply-web --account acme-corp --json`
Adds only supported missing linkedin_url, email, or phone fields
Does not claim the command performed a web search or independently verified identity
